seo.title: AI note taker for Mac with live captions | DialogTrack
seo.description: DialogTrack shows live captions for Zoom, Meet, Teams and any other call on your Mac, in 25 languages. It runs on-device with no bot. Join the free beta.
seo.ogTitle: Live captions for every call on your Mac, in 25 languages
seo.thanksTitle: You are on the beta list | DialogTrack

main.h1a: Live captions for every call on your Mac,
main.heroSub: DialogTrack records both sides of a call in Zoom, Meet, Teams, WhatsApp or any other app. It shows live captions under the notch and collects decisions and tasks by the time you hang up. Everything runs on your Mac. No recording leaves it.
main.sentHero: Done, you are on the list.
main.mockCaption: Example: during a Zoom call the island under the notch shows the recording, the caption window shows each line as it is spoken, and the Highlights card on the right keeps updating.

main.appsLead: Works wherever you can hear the call:
main.howH2: Follow every word and stop taking notes yourself
main.f1Title: Live captions on top of any app
main.f1Text: The caption window stays above Zoom or Meet. Speech turns into text while people talk, and there is no language to choose first.
main.f2Text: Lines are split by voice during the call. Name a speaker in one click and the name stays in the recording.
main.f2L1: The budget is approved until the end of the year.
main.f3Text: Topic, summary, decisions, tasks and open questions update as the call goes on. Each item links to the line it came from.
main.langSub: DialogTrack recognises each of these languages on its own. You pick nothing before the call. Choose a language to see a caption.
main.trText: Captions can be translated while you listen. English ↔ Russian works today. More pairs are added during the beta: tell us in the request which one you need.
main.a1Text: Search across the text and the translation. A timecode starts the audio from that moment.
main.a2Text: One button copies the conversation with the date, project and timecodes. Paste it into a chat and keep working.
main.a3Text: Text exports to TXT, SRT and VTT. You can record the whole screen or a selected area.
main.prH2: The recording stays on your Mac
main.prSub: Speech recognition, speaker separation, translation and summaries run on the computer itself. There is no server for a recording to leak to.
main.prArchive: Audio and text in an archive on your disk
main.prFact1: Internet is needed only to install the app and download language models.
main.prFact2: App logs contain no conversation text.
main.prFact3: Text reaches ChatGPT or Claude only if you paste it there yourself.
main.prConsent: Tell people you are recording the call. It is polite, and in some countries it is required.

faq.q: Do I need an internet connection?
faq.a: Only to install the app and download language models. After that, recording, transcription, translation and summaries work offline.
An Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or newer) with macOS 26 or later. The app does not run on Intel Macs.

Speech is recognised in 25 languages: Bulgarian, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish and Ukrainian. Live translation works between English and Russian today, and more pairs are on the way.

faq.q: Will the other people see that I am recording?
faq.a: Nobody joins the call: no bot and no extra participant. We still recommend telling people that you are recording. In some countries it is required.

faq.q: How is this different from Otter or Granola?
faq.a: They process recordings on their servers. DialogTrack does everything on your Mac, shows live captions on top of any app and understands 25 languages.
The beta is free. Afterwards a free version stays, and Pro will cost $[PRICE] a month. Beta testers get a founder discount.

faq.q: When will I get my invitation?
faq.a: We open the beta in waves so that we can answer everyone. An email with the installer link goes to the address in your request.
